outline.rationale: The user is a total beginner with no technical background whose goal is to follow AI news and conversations intelligently. The outline prioritizes intuition and real-world context over technical or hands-on content. Node 1 establishes the core definition; node 2 covers the central concept (learning from data) without math; node 3 targets LLMs/chatbots since these dominate current discourse; node 4 explains the recent surge (helps make sense of news framing); node 5 grounds concepts in recognizable examples; node 6 covers limitations that frequently appear in coverage (hallucinations, bias); node 7 addresses the societal debates (jobs, risk, regulation) that are unavoidable in conversations; node 8 is a reference glossary so they can decode terms encountered anywhere. Deliberately excluded: coding, building models, deep math, and a generic 'intro/conclusion.' Nodes are MECE-ish — definition, mechanism, the headline tech, history, applications, failures, societal debate, and vocabulary have low overlap.
